summary: The feature rebrands the installer-visible Windows strings, AppUserModel IDs, and AppX manifests, but the packaged Windows install still exposes the CLI launchers as `zed` instead of `neozed`, so the desktop package does not fully match the public Neo Zed command identity.

issues.description: Windows installers still package the CLI as `zed` instead of `neozed`, so users who add the installed `bin` directory to PATH do not get the public Neo Zed command name required by the rebrand.
issues.evidence: `script/bundle-windows.ps1` still moves `cli.exe` to `$innoDir\\bin\\zed.exe` and `zed.sh` to `$innoDir\\bin\\zed`, while `crates/zed/resources/windows/zed.iss` installs `{app}\\bin` and offers the `addtopath` task for that directory.
